title: DOM list operations — add, remove, filter
solution:
let todoList = ["Buy groceries", "Clean house", "Study JS"]
todoList.push("Exercise")
console.log(todoList)
todoList.shift()
console.log(todoList)
const idx = todoList.indexOf("Study JS")
todoList.splice(idx, 1)
console.log(todoList)
todoList.sort()
console.log(todoList)
const filtered = todoList.filter(item => item.length > 5)
console.log(filtered)
todoList.push("Meditate")
console.log(todoList.length)

tests.expected:
["Buy groceries", "Clean house", "Study JS", "Exercise"]
["Clean house", "Study JS", "Exercise"]
["Clean house", "Exercise"]
["Clean house", "Exercise"]
["Clean house"]
3

hints: push() end mein add, shift() shuru se remove — DOM list mein jaise items aate jaate hain
splice(index, 1) se specific item delete hota hai
filter() se sirf matching items rehte hain — jaise DOM se elements filter karte ho
